result.title: AI Can FINALLY Edit Videos For You
result.description:
Imagine typing "edit this for me" and letting AI handle your entire video timeline. 🤯

That's the promise behind Palmier, a new AI video editor powered by Claude. From organizing media and trimming clips to generating missing B-roll on the fly, it’s designed to automate the manual side of editing.

At $29/month for around 3 to 7 minutes of generated video, it's not the cheapest product to use, especially when you factor in potential revisions. BUT it's still probably cheaper than a professional video editor. 

I haven’t run any footage through it yet, but I'm curious to see how it performs and if it's worth it. Let me know in the comments if you'd want to see a hands-on test 👇🏻

#ai #videoediting #contentcreator

result.title: How to "Vibe Direct" Short Films
result.description:
We've gone from vibe coding to vibe DIRECTING.

Instead of prompting individual clips and stitching everything together afterward, you can now direct an entire video through conversation.

I used @openart_ai Director to create my own horror movie trailer by describing the story, characters, pacing, visuals, and voice performances, then refining everything through chat.

It can generate up to 5 minutes (NOT seconds!) of continuous video while keeping the characters, voices, and story consistent the whole way through.

If you’re interested in trying your hand at vibe directing, head to OpenArt.ai to get started.

#AI #genAI #aivideo #AIart

result.title: I Automated Shorts With Fable
result.description:
UPDATE: Anthropic announced they're extending access to Fable 5 on all paid plans through July 12.

Today is the day to try Fable! And I used it to build a fully automated social media video generator.

On July 7, Anthropic’s insanely good Fable model is going to get A LOT more expensive since you'll only be able to access it via usage credits on paid plans.

So I decided to see what I could build with it before that happens…

And in half a day, I vibe coded a fully automated social media video factory.

It can turn an article, raw text, file, or idea into a short-form script, fact-check it, generate B-roll, and even learn from my past Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to improve future scripts based on what’s actually performing.

Basically: a scriptwriter, researcher, editor assistant, teleprompter, and performance analyst all in one dashboard.

If you’ve been meaning to try Fable, don’t wait.

And save this video or send it to a friend who should try it before it's too late.

#AI #Anthropic #Fable #socialmedia #AItips
